name: L3 source-only gate: continuous meta-learned local plasticity on FALCON M1
owner: Claude (code/protocol); Codex audits before any human scoring
status: SOURCE ONLY. No H1 (human) L3 score is computed by this protocol or script; human scoring needs a separate amendment after Codex audits code and the source gate.
question: Can shared scalar coefficients of a two-layer local plasticity rule, meta-learned on macaque M1 (64 units -> 16 EMG), reconstruct held-out source targets from short labelled calibration prefixes, beyond the unchanged initial rule and a time-shifted source?

data.source: data/xspecies/falcon/000941/*.npz (FALCON M1 held-in calibration, one macaque, 64 units, 16 measured EMG, 20 ms bins); hashes in data/xspecies/falcon/export_manifest.json
data.validation_day: 20120928 (always real data, never used for generator profiles or meta-training)
data.eligible_rows: eval_mask rows only are labelled calibration or query rows; features use all bins causally
data.features: Fixed, not selected by L3: reference finite causal exponential kernel 240 ms reset at trial boundaries, current + 4 past bins (Codex V1 human-floor configuration, reused via scripts/wacv_falcon_floor_v2.features read-only). It was selected on H1 held-in development data, so feature choice is not source-only; it is shared by every method.

evaluation_design.type: calibration-prefix learning curve, frozen weights, no test feedback
evaluation_design.window: prefix = first 320 eligible rows from a start trial; budget b uses the first b of them; query = eligible rows of the next 8 whole trials after the trial holding row 320, identical for every budget and method; next window starts after the query
evaluation_design.normalisation: per budget, calibration rows only: inputs z-scored with sd floor 0.1 (wacv_falcon_floor_v2.normalise); targets centred per channel and divided by one pooled sd; predictions mapped back to raw units before scoring
evaluation_design.metric: official FALCON variance-weighted R2 per query window (wacv_falcon_floor_v2.scores, float64), averaged over windows; FALCON scores whole sessions, so per-window R2 is a diagnostic unit
evaluation_design.validation_split: day-4 windows in time order; first half = SELECTION (checkpoints, comparator hyperparameters, primary budget); second half = GATE (reported, never used for selection)
evaluation_design.no_prequential: No evaluation with feedback at query bins; therefore no last-label floor is needed. Any later prequential proposal must include a label-only autoregressive floor.

learner.network: x (z-scored) -> a0 = x/sqrt(d) -> h = softplus_beta10(W1 a0), a1 = h/sqrt(128) -> y = W2 a1; 128 hidden units; no biases
learner.fresh_per_episode: W1 ~ N(0,1), W2 = 0, fixed random feedback B1 ~ N(0,1/k) (k outputs -> hidden) and B0 ~ N(0,1/128) (hidden -> input) drawn afresh for every episode, window, draw and budget; within a window, one generator seed per (window, draw) gives IDENTICAL weights and feedback for every budget and for every rule arm and BP (paired learning curves); meta-training episodes likewise share one draw across their four budgets
learner.errors: e2 = y_hat - y; e1 = (e2 B1) * (1 - exp(-beta h)) as published; e0 = e1 B0 (MODIFICATION: inputs are signed z-scores, so no softplus-derivative factor at the input)
learner.update_per_layer_i: dW_ji = -theta0_i e_{i+1,j} a_{i,i'} - theta1_i e_{i+1,j} e_{i,i'} + theta2_i (a_{i+1,j} a_{i,i'} - a_{i+1,j}^2 W_ji). Terms 0 (pseudo-gradient) and 1 (eHebb, error_post x error_pre) are the published plasticity_rule terms of Shervani-Tabar & Rosenbaum 2023 optim.py, checked numerically equal to the downloaded code with the Oja coefficient at 0; term 2 is STRICTLY PER-NEURON Oja (checked against a scalar per-synapse loop), replacing the published subspace form (a_post^T a_post W), which depends on other postsynaptic neurons and weights
learner.inner_loop: one labelled bin per update (published batch size 1), one pass over the prefix in time order; no autograd in evaluation adaptation
learner.transferred_quantities: six scalars only (3 terms x 2 layers)
not_exact_replication: regression with squared-error teaching signal instead of softmax classification
two layers instead of five; fan-in scaling of activations (a0 = x/sqrt(d), a1 = h/sqrt(128)) so scalars are dimension-free across 64->176 units and 16->7 outputs
separate coefficients per layer (published shares Theta across layers)
input-layer error without derivative factor (signed inputs)
no L1 penalty on coefficients; meta-loss is 1 - pooled variance-weighted R2 on the query
per-neuron Oja replaces the published subspace Oja (main local rule); the published subspace form is not run
learner.outer_loop: global gradient meta-training (Adam 3e-3, grad-norm clip 1, 600 episodes, one episode = one fit-day window with all four budgets and a 4-trial query); outer gradients are not a local mechanism; supervised teaching errors are not rewards
learner.initial_rule: theta0 identical for both layers chosen from {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1} on 60 fixed real fit-day episodes; theta1 = theta2 = 0 (pure feedback alignment)
learner.checkpoints: every 100 episodes including 0; chosen by mean SELECTION R2 over budgets

source_arms_x_seeds_0_1_2.synthetic: train-profile-matched, not data-free: Poisson spikes with per-unit mean rates from the three fit days pooled and generic random linear tuning (depth 0.75, clipped) to the recorded EMG z-scored with fit-day moments; EMG targets unchanged; no day-4 moments
source_arms_x_seeds_0_1_2.time_shift: each fit session's spike matrix circularly shifted relative to its EMG by a seeded offset in [0.25, 0.75] of its length (preserves both autocorrelations, removes alignment)
source_arms_x_seeds_0_1_2.fa_only: real source, only theta0 meta-learned (theta1 = theta2 = 0): isolates eHebb/Oja from learning-rate retuning

comparators_same_windows_inputs_normalis.ridge: batch ridge with intercept (wacv_falcon_floor_v2.moments/solve), lambda per budget from {0.01,0.1,1,10,100} on SELECTION
comparators_same_windows_inputs_normalis.ewridge: exponentially weighted ridge (the RLS-with-forgetting family endpoint), forgetting per bin from {0.97,0.99,0.995,0.998}, lambda = selected ridge lambda, chosen on SELECTION
comparators_same_windows_inputs_normalis.nlms: readout-only normalised LMS on x, zero init, one bin per update, one pass, mu from {0.03,0.1,0.3,1} per budget on SELECTION
comparators_same_windows_inputs_normalis.bp: same network, same weight draws, exact backprop with Adam, one bin per update, one pass, lr from {1e-3,3e-3,1e-2,3e-2} per budget on SELECTION
comparators_same_windows_inputs_normalis.draws: 3 paired weight/feedback draws per window and budget for rule and BP arms

primary_budget: chosen on SELECTION windows only: the budget maximising mean over seeds of real-rule R2 minus the best of ridge/ewridge/nlms/bp at that budget

gate_on_GATE_windows_at_primary_budget.G1_not_weak: real-rule mean R2 >= max(0.10, 0.5 x ridge R2)
gate_on_GATE_windows_at_primary_budget.G2_learned_beyond_start: real minus initial rule: 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0 (10000 resamples over gate windows; seeds and draws averaged within window)
gate_on_GATE_windows_at_primary_budget.G3_source_alignment_matters: real minus time_shift: 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0
gate_on_GATE_windows_at_primary_budget.reported_not_gated: real minus synthetic, real minus fa_only, real minus ridge/ewridge/nlms/bp; all budgets
gate_on_GATE_windows_at_primary_budget.pass: G1 and G2 and G3. PASS only permits proposing a human protocol to Codex; FAIL is reported as is.

counts_reported: labelled prefix rows per budget (exact), trials spanned per budget, query rows and trials per window, eligible rows per fit day
compute: CPU only (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty), one BLAS/torch thread per worker, spawn pool

disclosures.initial_rule_is_real_source_knowledge: theta0 of the initial rule is tuned on REAL fit days and is the meta-training start for every arm, including synthetic and time_shift; it is additional real-source knowledge shared by the controls (as in L2)
disclosures.features_not_source_only: 240 ms / 5-bin features were selected on H1 human held-in development data (Codex V1), so the method is not fully source-only; they are fixed and shared by all methods
disclosures.interval_meaning: gate bootstrap intervals resample temporal windows of one animal on one day; they are conditional on that recording, not population or species intervals
disclosures.time_shift_caveat: the circular shift preserves RAW spike autocorrelation approximately; causal features are reset at the unchanged trial boundaries after the shift, so exact feature autocorrelation is not preserved and residual alignment is not proven absent
disclosures.human: no human L3 score until Codex audits code and the source gate

amendments.when: before any meta-fit; only the fit-day initial-rule grid had run (theta0 0.03 chosen; 0.3 and 1 diverged)
changes: draws paired across budgets and arms (seed excludes budget)
initial-rule grid re-run with the paired draws; non-finite grid losses ranked last

amendments.when: before any completed meta-fit: a first fit launch (commit 2680605) was stopped by Claude after ~18 s on Codex's second preflight; no fit file was written; its 2-line log archived unread as data/wacv/xspecies_l3/fit_aborted_v1.out
changes: outer RNG excludes the arm: identical outer episodes, windows and draws for every arm at a seed (only source spikes differ)

gradient finiteness checked before clipping/stepping; coefficients checked finite after the step (restored if not); physical bounds projected after each step: theta0 in [1e-4,1], |eHebb|<=1, |Oja|<=1; counts of updates, non-finite losses/gradients/coefficients and clamps saved
evaluation saves absolute prefix/query bin indices (windows.npz) and raw-unit predictions per method/draw (preds/*.npz) for independent rescoring
ridge/EW-ridge labelled closed-form endpoints, not runtime/memory-benchmarked RLS
added checks: raw calibration/query rows, normalisation invariance to query data, outer gradient vs central finite differences (float64)
smoke test (4 outer steps per arm) ran on SELECTION windows only, in a scratch directory; no GATE window was scored

amendments.when: during the 85b8d63 fits, before evaluate and before any GATE window was scored; prompted by NaN SELECTION-window checkpoint scores at budget 320 in the fit log (inner-loop divergence; seen by Claude and Codex)
changes: checkpoint eligibility made explicit: a checkpoint whose selection score is non-finite for any budget is ineligible (stability requirement); this equals the running fits' own max() behaviour and is asserted in evaluate

scoring of divergence, previously unspecified: a run with any non-finite prediction falls back to the calibration mean (zero update) for that window/budget/draw, for EVERY method; diverged-run counts per method and split are reported
rescore mode: independent recomputation of weighted R2 (1 - sum SSres / sum SStot) from saved raw-unit predictions and raw M1 targets read at the saved absolute query bins
no refit, no change to the rule, bounds or budgets
